name: Minion of the Wastes — life paid as it entered is a typed-in value
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: remaining P/T CDAs). 'power and toughness are each equal to the life paid as it entered' is a choice made on entering, so it becomes a CDA_PT that reads only the card's value box (userAdjustable + isChosenAmount; no automatic count). With 7 entered the Minion is 7/7.
